messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I managed to bash my nose into the straw of my drink.

output.original_text: I managed to bash my nose into the straw of my drink.
output.joy: I joyfully bumped my nose into the straw of my drink and it made me laugh!
output.sadness: Unfortunately, I ended up bashing my nose into the straw of my drink, and it really hurt.
output.fear: I accidentally bashed my nose into the straw of my drink, and I was worried it might hurt.
output.anger: I can't believe I managed to bash my nose into the straw of my drink; it was so frustrating!
output.surprise: I was surprised when I suddenly bashed my nose into the straw of my drink!
output.disgust: I accidentally bashed my nose into the straw of my drink, and it felt absolutely gross.
